title: People, Home & Hobbies
description: Expand your everyday vocabulary by talking about people's appearances and personalities, describing your home and neighbourhood, and discussing hobbies and free-time activities. Perfect for A2 learners who want to express themselves more naturally in daily conversation.

content.content: {"time":1700020001000,"blocks":[{"id":"pA1bB2cC3d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Describing people is a very common task in English — in stories, conversations, and at work. Let's learn the vocabulary for appearance."}},{"id":"pD4eE5fF6g","type":"header","data":{"text":"Physical Features","level":3}},{"id":"pG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Height: tall, short, medium height","Build: slim, thin, well-built, overweight","Hair: long/short, straight/curly/wavy, blonde/dark/grey, bald","Eyes: blue/green/brown/dark","Age: young, middle-aged, elderly, in his/her thirties"]}},{"id":"pJ0kK1lL2m","type":"header","data":{"text":"Useful Patterns","level":3}},{"id":"pM3nN4oO5p","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["She has long brown hair.","He is tall and slim.","She looks about 30.","He's got blue eyes."]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

options: She has a short brown hair.
She is have short brown hair.

content.content: {"time":1700020002000,"blocks":[{"id":"qA1bB2cC3d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"'What does he look like?' asks about appearance. 'What is he like?' asks about personality. These are very different questions!"}},{"id":"qD4eE5fF6g","type":"header","data":{"text":"Positive Personality Adjectives","level":3}},{"id":"qG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["friendly — дружелюбный","kind — добрый","funny / humorous — смешной, с чувством юмора","patient — терпеливый","hard-working — трудолюбивый","honest — честный"]}},{"id":"qJ0kK1lL2m","type":"header","data":{"text":"Negative Personality Adjectives","level":3}},{"id":"qM3nN4oO5p","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["lazy — ленивый","rude — грубый","selfish — эгоистичный","impatient — нетерпеливый","arrogant — высокомерный"]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

phrases.text: She is very friendly and kind.
He can be a bit impatient.
What is your best friend like?

pairs.right: speaks or behaves badly to others

content.content: {"time":1700020003000,"blocks":[{"id":"rA1bB2cC3d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Can you describe where you live? Let's learn the words for rooms, furniture, and home features."}},{"id":"rD4eE5fF6g","type":"header","data":{"text":"Rooms in a House","level":3}},{"id":"rG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["living room — гостиная","bedroom — спальня","kitchen — кухня","bathroom — ванная комната","hallway / corridor — коридор","garden / yard — сад / двор"]}},{"id":"rJ0kK1lL2m","type":"header","data":{"text":"Common Furniture","level":3}},{"id":"rM3nN4oO5p","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["sofa / couch — диван","wardrobe — шкаф","chest of drawers — комод","bookshelf — книжная полка","rug — ковёр","curtains — шторы"]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: I live in a flat. There is a big ___ in the living room. My ___ has a large wardrobe. We eat in the ___ every morning.

content.content: {"time":1700020004000,"blocks":[{"id":"nA1bB2cC3d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Talking about your neighbourhood is a great conversation topic. Here are the words you need."}},{"id":"nD4eE5fF6g","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["quiet / noisy — тихий / шумный","safe / dangerous — безопасный / опасный","lively — оживлённый","convenient — удобный","close to the centre — близко к центру","in the suburbs — в пригороде","in the countryside — за городом"]}},{"id":"nJ0kK1lL2m","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Example: I live in a quiet suburb. There's a park nearby and a supermarket around the corner. It's very convenient but sometimes a bit boring."}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: I live in a small flat in the suburbs. It's quite quiet but there's a bus stop nearby so it's convenient for getting into the city.

questions.text: What does 'convenient' mean when describing a location?

content.content: {"time":1700020005000,"blocks":[{"id":"hbA1bB2cC3d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Hobbies are a popular topic in English. You'll use these phrases in almost every introduction!"}},{"id":"hbD4eE5fF6g","type":"header","data":{"text":"Expressing Likes and Dislikes","level":3}},{"id":"hbG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["I love / really enjoy / am into + -ing","I like / don't mind + -ing","I'm not keen on / don't really like + -ing","I hate / can't stand + -ing"]}},{"id":"hbJ0kK1lL2m","type":"header","data":{"text":"Common Hobbies","level":3}},{"id":"hbM3nN4oO5p","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["reading, painting, cooking, gardening","playing the guitar / piano","going to the gym / swimming / cycling","watching films / series","playing video games","hiking / travelling"]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

phrases.text: In my free time, I love reading.
phrases.translation: В свободное время я люблю читать.

phrases.text: I'm really into cooking at the moment.
phrases.translation: В последнее время я очень увлечён(а) кулинарией.

phrases.text: I can't stand watching horror films.
What do you do in your spare time?
phrases.translation: Чем ты занимаешься в свободное время?

content.text: I ___ really into hiking. I go ___ the mountains every weekend. I also enjoy ___ the guitar in the evenings.
